content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational and cultural qualifications to apply for South Eastern Railway Group C: Passed 12th or its equivalent Examination with not less than 50% marks in the aggregate, from Government recognized Education Board (50% mark is not insisted for SC/ST/ESM/PWBD candidates and those with higher qualifications from a UGC recognized University); OR Passed 10th from a recognized Board Plus ITI/National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) approved by NCVT for Technician Grade-III in Level-2 of Pay Matrix of 7th CPC. Possess a Degree/Diploma/Certificate course in the respective discipline only from a Government recognized University/Institute. Candidates not possessing the prescribed cultural qualification need not apply. Age limit ranges from 18 to 30 years for UR candidates as on 01.01.2027, with upper age relaxations up to 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST candidates, along with specific relaxations for serving railway employees, widows, divorced women, PwBD, and ex-servicemen. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for South Eastern Railway Group C
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of RRC/SER at www.rrcser.co.in and navigate to the Recruitment Cell. Click on the online/E-Application for Cultural Quota/2026-27 link and select New Application. Fill in personal details such as name, father's name, date of birth, community, e-mail address, and mobile number to receive the registration number and password. Log in using the credentials, complete the application form, and upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, LTI, and required certificates. Pay the prescribed examination fee online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card. Submit the application and download the final application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves two stages. Stage I consists of a Written Test / OMR / CBT comprising objective-type multiple-choice questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, General Mathematics, General English, Official Language, Professional Knowledge, Reasoning, and Aptitude. The duration is 60 minutes with a 1/3rd negative marking for incorrect answers and a qualifying percentage of 40%. Candidates qualifying Stage I are called for Stage II in a 1:5 ratio, which involves an assessment of talent comprising a practical demonstration in the applied discipline (35 marks) and testimonials/prizes in the applied discipline (15 marks).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for South Eastern Railway Group C Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for general and reserved categories?
faq.answer: The examination fee is Rs. 500/- for all candidates except SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwBD, Women, Minorities, and Economically Backward Classes, who pay Rs. 250/-. Both fees have provisions for partial refunds for those who actually appear in the written examination.

faq.question: Q3. What age relaxation is applicable for OBC and SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: OBC candidates receive an upper age relaxation of up to 3 years, while SC/ST candidates receive an upper age relaxation of up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th standard with at least 50% marks (relaxable for specific categories) or 10th standard plus ITI/NAC, along with a Degree, Diploma, or Certificate in the relevant cultural discipline from a recognized university or institute.
